_about: Audit of the 12 implemented Emergent recipes. Stored categories unchanged; displayCategory is the interim UI mapping (lunch/dinner → Meals).

recipes.name: Miso Mushroom & Kale Soup
recipes.rationale: A broth with buckwheat, mushrooms and greens, stored as dinner, is served as a main-course soup.
recipes.notes: Protein is light (no tofu or seafood tagged), so it eats like a lighter main. Still Meals, not a snack. Tagged Kombu and Tamari: check the salt and iodine per serving.

recipes.name: Beet & Adzuki Wild Rice Bowl
recipes.rationale: A grain-and-legume bowl with vegetables is a complete main meal.

recipes.name: Warm Blueberry Buckwheat Porridge
recipes.rationale: A warm porridge with fruit and seeds is a classic breakfast.

recipes.name: Zesty Lentil & Broccoli Bowl
recipes.rationale: A lentil-and-vegetable bowl with seeds is built as a main dish.

recipes.name: Citrus Oat Breakfast Bowl
recipes.rationale: An oat bowl with fruit and seeds; the name itself says breakfast.
recipes.notes: Tagged “Nut butter”: name the nut for allergy filtering (see data-quality flags).

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Chicken with Artichoke & Peas
recipes.rationale: Chicken with vegetables and barley is a complete main course.
recipes.notes: The design mock-up shows a different, invented recipe (“Lemon Herb Chicken & Barley Bowl”, with zucchini, Dijon and garlic). Replace it with this real recipe.

recipes.name: Quinoa Salmon Power Bowl
recipes.rationale: Salmon, quinoa and vegetables make a complete main meal.

recipes.name: Berry Coconut Amaranth Porridge
recipes.rationale: A grain porridge with fruit and nuts is a breakfast format.
recipes.notes: Tagged “Chocolate”: specify dark chocolate and a small amount.

recipes.name: Red Lentil, Spinach & Tomato Dal
recipes.rationale: A lentil dal is a main dish, usually served with rice or bread.
recipes.notes: Consider suggesting a whole grain on the side; no change made.

recipes.name: Roasted Sweet Potato & Chickpea Tray
recipes.rationale: A tray bake with chickpeas, vegetables and brown rice is a complete main.

recipes.name: Ginger Pumpkin Soup
recipes.rationale: Stored as lunch and eaten as a bowl of soup, it works as a light main rather than a between-meals snack.
recipes.notes: No protein source beyond sunflower seeds, so it's a light meal. Don't relabel it Snacks; a pairing suggestion such as bread or beans would be a content decision.

recipes.name: Baked Apple & Pear Millet Bowl
recipes.rationale: A warm millet bowl with baked fruit and nuts is a breakfast format.
recipes.notes: Could double as a dessert, but its stored category and grain base support Breakfast.
